title: Preparation of 100x M2 Medium
author: Sarah Seyffert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uqnevve

steps.title: Prepare 0.25 M Na₂‑EDTA stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.32 g Na₂‑EDTA powder in Milli‑Q nuclease‑free water and bring the volume to 25 mL; adjust the pH to 8.0 with diluted NaOH.

steps.title: Add CaCl₂·2H₂O (or anhydrous) to flask
steps.instruction: To a 1 L vessel add either 3.6 g CaCl₂·2H₂O (hydrated) or, if only anhydrous CaCl₂ is available, add 2.718 g CaCl₂.

steps.title: Add K₂HPO₄ to flask
steps.instruction: Add 82.3 g K₂HPO₄ to the same vessel (per litre of final medium).

steps.title: Add MgSO₄·7H₂O (or anhydrous) to flask
steps.instruction: Add 7.49 g MgSO₄·7H₂O (hydrated) or, if only anhydrous MgSO₄ is available, add 3.659 g MgSO₄ (per litre).

steps.title: Add 0.25 M Na₂‑EDTA stock solution
steps.instruction: Pipette 0.56 mL of the prepared 0.25 M Na₂‑EDTA stock into the vessel (per litre).

steps.title: Bring volume to 1 L with water
steps.instruction: Fill the mixture with Milli‑Q water up to a final volume of 1 L.

steps.title: Stir solution until homogeneous
steps.instruction: Mix the solution with a magnetic stir bar until fully dissolved and uniform.
